name: FormPortal
title: one place to install, open and update every FormAI app
summary: FormPortal installs, opens, updates and rolls back every FormAI app, with no account and no background process. Free and open-source under GPL-3.0.
lede: FormPortal reads the signed Form family catalogue and offers this computer the right build of every FormAI app. It checks each download's SHA-256 before unpacking, installs per user with no administrator, and keeps the version it replaced so one step back is always there. The same engine runs the window, a command line and an MCP server.
runs_on: macOS, Windows and Linux (build targets: all)
checks: Installs each FormAI app per user with no administrator, from zip, AppImage, deb, rpm, dmg, msi or NSIS.
Keeps the version it replaced so one step back is always there, and keeps a beta beside the stable build.
Refuses any download whose SHA-256 does not match, before unpacking; no flag skips the hash.
No account and no tray process; FormPortal checks when it is open and stops when you close it.

facts.dd: Rust (formportal-core, formportal-cli) in a Tauri 2 shell with a vanilla TypeScript interface
39 MCP tools for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor
Stable, beta and nightly, each its own install

chapters.title: Right build, checked before it unpacks
chapters.text: FormPortal reads the signed catalogue and offers the right build of every FormAI app for this computer. An Ed25519-signed catalogue and a SHA-256 per file are checked before anything is unpacked.

chapters.title: Roll back and run betas side by side
chapters.text: Every update keeps the version it replaced, and each channel is its own install. An update can wait until you close the app, and Check and repair fixes broken installs and leftovers.

chapters.title: One engine, three surfaces
chapters.text: The core does catalogue, verify, install, rollback, remove and launch with no window in it. The window, the command line and the MCP server are thin layers over it, so an agent and a person see the same installs.

parity.summary: FormPortal was measured against 71 capabilities of Adobe's Creative Cloud desktop app, alongside JetBrains Toolbox, Setapp and Autodesk Access, with FormPortal's cells traced through its code at 0.44.5. Rows for cloud files, fonts, stock, social feed and paid extensions are marked as non-goals but still count against it.

requirements: WebKitGTK 4.1 on Linux (libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev librsvg2-dev libssl-dev pkg-config build-essential)
docs.agents: ./formportal agents install adds the MCP server and the formportal-harness skill to Claude Code, Codex and Cursor; ./formportal mcp serves it on stdio.

topics.title: Quick Start
topics.text: The README gives requirements and commands for macOS, Linux and Windows (formportal_oc_install.bat, formportal.bat); the first boot compiles the shell, which takes a few minutes.

topics.title: Command line
topics.text: ./formportal cli apps lists the family; ./formportal cli install formcut --channel beta installs a beta.

topics.title: Configuration
topics.text: The README lists FORMPORTAL_ROOT, FORMPORTAL_CATALOG, FORMPORTAL_POLICY and other variables, and explains the catalogue key.

topics.title: Interface alone
topics.text: cd frontend && npm run dev serves the interface at http://localhost:3250 on the sample catalogue.

topics.title: Wiki
topics.text: Wiki pages live in .docs/wiki: Home, Getting Started, Architecture, Agents and Releasing.

items: The installers and the app metadata name NodeAgentc, Inc. as the publisher, with the licence
The built-in app list names FormSlide's real identifier and repository
Installers ship as they are, with no zip around them, and an .rpm for Linux
On Linux and Windows the installer is also the update file
FormPortal's own updates come from the public download store at dl.formai.studio
Links to the Form repositories point at the nodemode-dev organisation, and FormPortal opens every link it shows
This build trusts the family's production catalogue key
